description: Continuation audit fixes for five confirmed erroneous catalog records

fixes.name: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio

before.details:
Start: Timfraku in Tai Bwo Wannai
Difficulty: Intermediate • Length: Medium
Reward: 2 Quest Points
Requirements: Jungle Potion, 15 Agility, 30 Cooking, 15 Fishing
before.source_ref: Pre-consolidation PoiIndex/PoiDetails snapshot; identity not globally verified; poi/curated-details.tsv:1670

after.details:
Start: Timfraku in Tai Bwo Wannai
Difficulty: Intermediate • Length: Medium
Reward: 2 Quest Points
Requirements: Jungle Potion, 15 Agility, 30 Cooking, 5 Fishing
after.source_ref: Pre-consolidation PoiIndex/PoiDetails snapshot; identity not globally verified; poi/curated-details.tsv:1670; description corrected 2026-10-08 against https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tai_Bwo_Wannai_Trio?oldid=14918129

fixes.rationale: Corrected factual error in Fishing requirement from 15 to 5. Stated Timfraku start in Tai Bwo Wannai is correct for the quest NPC, but authored coordinates (2900, 3500, 0) near Heroes' Guild/Taverley conflict with Timfraku's observed spawn at (2780, 3087, 1) NW Tai Bwo Wannai (poi_003672). Coordinates preserved at authored tile as unresolved placement conflict pending authoritative deduplication/relocation.
fixes.remaining_gaps: Marker placement unresolved; duplicate quest marker of canonical poi_003672.

Difficulty: Experienced • Length: Long
Reward: 2 Quest Points

after.source_ref: Pre-consolidation PoiIndex/PoiDetails snapshot; identity not globally verified; poi/curated-details.tsv:1624; description corrected 2026-10-08 against https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_I?oldid=14917676

fixes.rationale: Corrected reward from 3 Quest Points to 2 Quest Points. Corrected initial quest start to Guildmaster at Champions' Guild (Oziach is spoken to subsequent to the Guildmaster, not an initial start alternative). fixes.remaining_gaps: Marker placement unresolved; duplicate quest marker of canonical poi_001426.

Difficulty: Novice • Length: Short

fixes.remaining_gaps: Marker placement unresolved; duplicate quest marker of canonical poi_001791.

fixes.name: Fishing spot

before.details:
Method / Fish: Common Tench
Tools: Net, Rod + Bait, Pot, or Harpoon

Greater siren
before.source_ref: Pre-consolidation PoiIndex/PoiDetails snapshot; identity not globally verified

after.details:
Method / Fish: Common Tench, Greater siren
Catch method: Aerial fishing with Cormorant's glove
Bait: King worms or Fish offcuts
Requirements: 56 Fishing / 51 Hunter (Common tench), 91 Fishing / 87 Hunter (Greater siren)

fixes.rationale: Replaced incorrect generic fishing tools (Net, Rod, Pot, Harpoon) with accurate aerial fishing mechanics: Cormorant's glove, king worms/fish offcuts bait, and paired Fishing/Hunter requirements (Common tench: 56 Fishing / 51 Hunter; Greater siren: 91 Fishing / 87 Hunter).
fixes.remaining_gaps: Live client in-game tooltip re-render pending next client sideload build.
